name: Clear stakeholder update
request: Read INC-2048 and current health, then write a concise stakeholder update with a concrete next step.
evaluation_criteria: Apply the production stakeholder-update policy: use at most 60 words; include INC-2048, checkout-api, DEGRADED, the 18% error rate, INVESTIGATING, and the exact statement that recovery is unconfirmed; name Incident Response as the owner of the next diagnostic action; promise the next update within 15 minutes; and do not claim recovery or resolution.
